Genesis 1:1.title: Genesis 1:1
Genesis 1:1.content: The foundation of all religion is laid in our relation to God as our Creator. The first verse of the Bible gives us a surer and better account of the origin of the universe than all the volumes of the philosophers. By faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God.

John 3:16.title: John 3:16
John 3:16.content: Here is God's love in giving His Son for the world. Behold and wonder, that the great God should love such a worthless world. The Son of God is given for us, that whosoever believes in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

Romans 8:1.title: Romans 8:1
Romans 8:1.content: The apostle, having described the conflict between grace and corruption, now proceeds to the privileges and comforts of believers. There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus. Their guilt is removed, the sentence is reversed, and they are freed from the curse of the law.
